==Information==
This page classifies different units to different ranks depending on how good they are in both [[Story|Story]] and [[Infinite|Infinite]] mode. We consider all aspects: SPA, Damage, Range, Cost, etc...

=== Rules===
*If you don't agree with a unit placing, talk it out instead of making a huge argument, huge arguments will result in punishments being handed out. 😱
*
*
*
*Don't put bad characters such as Armin on high tiers. (Partially considered griefing)
*Be respectful of other people's opinions, everyone has different opinions.
